windows.why: Owners on Windows 10 and 11 print fine once set up, either with HP's app, HP's full software, or the built-in Windows driver over USB, but Wi-Fi setup, offline status and app detection failures recur and several threads end with no confirmed fix.
windows.driver: HP's full-feature software (a volunteer reply dates it to 24 March 2022) or the basic driver from HP's Windows 11 downloads, and the built-in Windows driver used over USB (reported to work on Windows 11 in 2022). HP Smart is optional, not required.
problems: Wi-Fi setup fails with error -3 after a network or PC change (fixed by a factory reset and setup on the 2.4 GHz band, after splitting a dual-band router that uses one shared name; thread 9230238)

HP app cannot detect the printer, shows 'Driver Unavailable' or 'impossible to install' (no confirmed fix; HP replies only give generic steps such as reinstalling the full software and restarting the Print Spooler)
Setup stalls at the WPS PIN step after the printer appears as DIRECT-1d, with the Wi-Fi light blinking (no answer in thread 9255878)
Orange attention light blinking and printing stops (suggested fixes: power drain and firmware update, from an HP moderator; no confirmation from the poster; thread 9085573)

Attention light and a 'Door open' message with the printer closed, and an HP app registration error OW_4XX_OWSWS00001 (HP volunteer suggests removing packaging plastic from inside, then re-doing Wi-Fi setup by video; no confirmed result; thread 9438018)
M110we only: 'verify account' and 'not connected to internet' Instant Ink account error (no fix in the thread, which asks the poster to send account details privately; thread 8386448)
M110we only: red light blinking after a genuine HP W1410A toner was not recognised (fixed by a printer reset and reinstall; thread 9645455)

sources.what: HP Community administrator reply (Windows 11, M110w): download the full HP app or basic driver from HP's Windows 11 page, connect by USB or Wi-Fi, HP app optional; may need USB temporarily for Wi-Fi setup.
Owner (Windows 11, 2022, M110w): Windows used the built-in driver over USB, test page and prints worked without HP Smart; a volunteer says HP Smart gives more print options.

Solved thread (Windows 11, M110w): error -3 after a network change; a volunteer gives the full-feature software date (24 March 2022); fix was to split the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, since the printer only uses 2.4 GHz.
Windows 11 owner (Dec 2024, M110w): HP app could not detect the printer on Windows or Android; printer appeared as DIRECT-1d; WPS PIN not in documents. No answer shown.
Owner (Sept 2024): HP app buggy and printer shows not available; moderator reply gives generic steps (full driver, spooler restart, manual add, Windows update). No confirmation.
Owner (Nov 2024, labelled M110we): 'Driver Unavailable' with Wi-Fi connected; HP administrator's generic steps (default printer, reinstall driver, HP app, firmware). No confirmation.
Windows 11 owner (May 2024, M110w): printing stopped with the orange light flashing; HP moderator suggests a power drain and a firmware update.
Owner (July 2025, M110w): attention light blinking, 'Door open' message and HP app error OW_4XX_OWSWS00001; volunteer suggests removing packaging plastic and redoing Wi-Fi setup.
M110we only (2022, Windows 11): 'verify account' and 'not connected to internet' Instant Ink error; the thread asks for account details by private message. Unresolved in the page read.
M110we only (April 2026, Windows 11): red light blinking, Instant Ink cancelled, genuine HP W1410A toner not recognised; solved by a printer reset and reinstall.

forums.why: Shop ratings are positive (4.3 out of 5 from 175 Best Buy reviews, 4 out of 5 from 14 on zap.co.il), but the review text could not be read, and HP support threads show Wi-Fi setup failures that often end without a fix

stars.checked: Coordinator re-read Best Buy on 2026-11-17: the M110w tile shows 4.3 out of 5 with 175 reviews. The first figure (4.4 from 354) belonged to the Brother HL-L2460DW shown on the same page.

praise: very compact, the smallest laser printer one owner found (zap, Nov 2025)
print quality and speed described as good (zap, 2025)
phone-app setup over Bluetooth was quick, with no HP account needed (zap, Dec 2024, a Linux PC)
complaints: paper tray is short and needs several sheets to feed (zap, 2023)
slow from pressing print to paper (zap, one year of use)
HP app failed to set up one owner, but a manual install worked (zap, 2023)
a 2025 owner warns that after using a non-HP cartridge, a firmware update may stop it working (zap, Nov 2025)
a non-HP cartridge showed 'Err 11 ... non-HP chip' (HP Community thread 9667296; this thread is about the M139w, not the M110w)

sources.what: zap.co.il owner reviews for the M110w: 14 reviews, shown as 4 out of 5; mostly positive on size and setup, with complaints on toner cost, connection drops and a short paper tray.
Best Buy product page for the M110w (model M110W/7MD66F): first rating shown is 4.4 out of 5 from 354 reviews. The review list on the Best Buy reviews pages did not load, so no review text is used.

forums.why_was: Only two owner-opinion pages with star ratings could be read (zap.co.il's 14 reviews and the Best Buy product rating, whose review text did not load), which is below the three-source minimum, so the star figures are reported but not rated.
forums.rated_by: Coordinator, after re-reading the Best Buy figure; the researcher had left it unrated for having two sources.
